elements.title: A Moonlit Moonwalk
elements.content: A nighttime photograph shows a NASA astronaut in a spacesuit collecting a soil sample in a rocky, desert-like volcanic field, with other people and equipment nearby under a dark blue sky. Printed caption: “NASA astronaut Kate Rubins places a sample marker in the soil before collecting a sample during a nighttime simulated moonwalk in the San Francisco Volcanic Field in Northern Arizona on May 16, 2024. A sample marker provides a photographic reference point for science samples collected on the lunar surface.” Photo credit: “NASA/Josh Valcarcel”.
